title: Fixed guest custody role startup
$comment: Data grammar only. Canonical UTF8 sorted JSON without LF, bootstrap <=16384 bytes and passive startup notice <=1024 bytes. Actual private parent/child PIDFD custody, independently signed role/config/delivery/generation, current boot, immutable originals and original deadlines are enforced by source owners. No input command, readiness permission, retry or host fallback is defined.

ns.$comment: Actual parser also enforces <=u64::MAX, canonical positive decimal, and the original absolute CLOCK_BOOTTIME deadline.

path.$comment: Source bounds UTF8 bytes and rejects empty/dot/dotdot components. These are cold consistency inputs only; the independent signed configuration and delivery bind exact original bytes.

bootstrap.$comment: FD5 root:root0600, regular memfd, nlink0, all four immutable seals. FD3 actual root launch-parent AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET with real parent SO_PEERPIDFD/getppid join; FD4 absent. Only router receives complete listener6/7 + inspector8/9/10 originals. Unsigned sealed bootstrap cannot invent or renew the signed delivery startup window or actual source-owned parent lifetime.

startup.$comment: Exactly one listening then one started, no replay/restart. Parent independently authenticates actual final signed role SCM_CREDENTIALS and SCM_PIDFD against its owned child. Listening follows real local service readiness; started follows local generation artifact publication, and for state-authority also actual full activation success. A passive notice does not substitute for the signed backend generation result or establish whole product readiness.
